title: THE ANOINTING OIL IS ON YOU

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting or you will die, because the LORD's anointing oil is on you.' So they did as Moses said." - Lev 10:7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Because the LORD's anointing oil is on you.

That is the reason given. Not "because you must be strong," not "because grief is weakness." Because you have been set apart, and this is your post.

Aaron and his remaining sons stay where God placed them, on the worst day of their lives.

The chapter ends this section with four quiet words: So they did as Moses said. After everything — the deaths, the bodies carried out, the forbidden mourning — they obeyed.

That is a kind of faith that rarely gets celebrated. Not the faith that moves mountains, but the faith that stays at its post when nothing makes sense.

Job, having lost everything, said: Though he slay me, yet will I hope in him (Job 13:15). Peter, when many disciples abandoned Jesus, said: Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life (Jn 6:68) — not enthusiasm, but nowhere else to turn.

If you are staying faithful right now without understanding, without feeling, without answers, God sees that. It may be the truest worship you ever offer.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I staying faithful in a season I do not understand?
2. What does obedience look like for me today, regardless of how I feel?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I do not understand everything You allow. Help me to stay where You have placed me and trust You even when I cannot see. Amen.
